finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the length of record.name, record.surname, or record.city exceeds 14 characters, it will overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: The Record structure has fixed-size character arrays for name, surname, and city, each with a size of 15. The input data is not validated to ensure it does not exceed these bounds.

parsed.change_summary: Added field width specifiers to the printf format strings to limit the number of characters printed to 14.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the printf format strings now include field width specifiers (e.g., %.14s), which limit the number of characters printed to 14. This prevents buffer overflow by ensuring that no more than 14 characters are printed from each of the record's name, surname, and city fields, even if the input data exceeds this length.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for bounds checks before the strcpy and printf calls; none found. Searched for constant arguments or unreachable code paths; none present. No neutralising checks were identified.
